final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM group_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT g.SEX, g.avg_ratio FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE g.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM first_kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.avg_ratio, f.mean_ratio AS first_mean, s.mean_ratio AS second_mean FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE k.avg_ratio > s.mean_ratio) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM remaining
